readme_excerpt: Awesome Compose > A curated list of Docker Compose samples. These samples provide a starting point for how to integrate different services using a Compose file and to manage their deployment with Docker Compose. > Note > The following samples are intended for use in local development environments such as project setups, tinkering with software stacks, etc. These samples must not be deployed in production environments.
